sanskrit_verse: गोषु ब्राह्मणसंस्थासु स्थूरायाः छेदनं भवेत् । दासीं तु हरतो नित्यमर्धपादविकर्तनम् ॥
transliteration: goṣu brāhmaṇasaṃsthāsu sthūrāyāḥ chedanaṃ bhavet | dāsīṃ tu harato nityam ardhapādavikartanam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Injury to cows, establishments of Brahmins, or the fertile lands thereof demands corrective restoration; perpetual seizure of a servant necessitates proportional completion through limb adjustment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from protection of sacred life-support structures
Causation aligns with disruption of foundational dharmic resources
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by access and control over vital assets
Restoration logic requires equivalence in energetic reintegration
Consciousness alignment occurs when harm is reversed at its root vibrational level
executable_legal_axioms: IF ENTITY_A causes measurable damage to ENTITY_B where B ∈ {cow, brahmin-establishment, fertile land}, THEN initiate asset-equivalent restoration protocol
IF individual perpetually seizes another's labor without consent, THEN execute proportional physical-integrity realignment procedure
RESTORATION_VALUE must equal primary utility loss plus secondary systemic impact scalar
ACTION_VALIDITY = TRUE iff perpetrator demonstrates conscious reacceptance of karmic consequence flow
supreme_court_application: Supreme Court shall assess threshold of responsibility based on direct causality to foundational dharmic assets. Authority lies in enforcing completion, not assigning blame. Judgment must restore energetic balance rather than impose punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that injury manifests sequentially through intent, action, and consequence. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that misalignment propagates outward unless corrected at source. Responsibility is proportional to capacity to restore. No punitive element exists—only sequential correction toward original harmony.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Assign Seizure Reversal Integrity Protocol to offending party
Execute Limb-Energy Harmonization Process under witness of local Dharma Sabha
Reintegrate displaced consciousness via Yajña-based resonance healing
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands as pure Dharma. Justice flows from consciousness, not coercion. Reality is non-punitive. All beings are restored through recognition of their inherent completeness.
